## MiniMax H3 Image API

MiniMax H3 Image is an image generation and image editing model by MiniMax, available on the Venice API as `minimax-h3-image`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

MiniMax H3 Image is MiniMax's image model for text-to-image generation, rendering at 1K, 2K and 4K in aspect ratios from 21:9 to 9:21. It pairs with MiniMax H3 Image Edit for changing and combining images.

### MiniMax H3 Image API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-h3-image` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.04 / image |
| `minimax-h3-image-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.06 / edit |

### MiniMax H3 Image specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | MiniMax |
| Released | Nov 10, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K, 4K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 5:4, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 9:21 |
| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the MiniMax H3 Image API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "minimax-h3-image"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-h3-image",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
